area: Global Search V2 - V1 Regression Suite
title: Searching an asset's licence plate finds that asset
permissions_required: A user with Customers access (assets are gated on Customers access).
preconditions: An asset (vehicle) exists with a licence plate recorded on it, and the plate is not blank.
The asset belongs to a customer in the organization you are signed in to.
Note the asset's full licence plate exactly as it is saved on the asset record.
Fewer than 20 contacts on the owning customer (see Notes - this keeps the check clean).
steps: Open global search from the top navigation bar.
Type the asset's FULL licence plate, exactly as it is saved on the asset record.
expected: The asset appears in the results.
It appears under the group heading 'Assets'.
The result row identifies the asset (its year, make and model), with the owning customer shown alongside it.
provenance_intro: This is the expected behaviour based on the EXISTING behaviour BEFORE the V2 deployment (the V1 regression baseline), not on assumption.
provenance_bullets: Traceable source: INV-92 - ShopView/shopview@5576716 - FetchDataQueryHandler.php:292, where licence_plate is concatenated into the searchable index for assets.

The V2 spec (Global Search - Product Requirements v1.5, Confluence page 576978945) is SILENT on licence plate as an indexed asset field - the term does not appear anywhere in the specification, in requirements.md, or in any of the 119 V2 case bodies.
Under the V1-to-V2 invariant rule, silence means 'must not change', so this behaviour must still hold after V2. If a licence-plate search stops finding the asset, that is a regression to raise.
automation_marker: AUTOMATION: Not available on Build to test Yet - Last checked 9/9/2026
design_ref: V1 behaviour baseline (fact); not a design artefact.
spec_ref: parity-2026-09-09 invariant INV-92 (new; not in the 2026-08-26 set of 33)
notes: Deliberately uses the FULL licence plate. Whether a PARTIAL plate must also match is open as PO-GS-SUBSTR-1 - V1 matches identifiers by substring (useGlobalSearch.ts:90-92 uses .includes()), while V2 cases GS-FUZ-06/08/11 say identifiers 'require an exact match after normalization'. A full-plate search passes under BOTH readings, so this case is safe to run before that question is answered. The under-20-contacts precondition avoids the group_concat_max_len truncation described in build/global-search/regression-v15-recheck-2026-09-09/MATRIX-CORRECTIONS-2026-09-09.md (register item R-GCML).
